full_judgment: 11. In the case of Jamshed Akbar Latu @ Jamshed Ali vs State reported in 2006 BLD 373 at page 379 para 12 = 12 BLC 351 , it has been observed that Nari-o-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain, 2000 is a special law having special provisions with a purpose to eliminate vigorously oppressive acts against women and children. Section 3 of the Ain, 2000 declares the overriding effect of the Ain which contemplates that notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in force the provisions of the Ain shall prevail. In the case Safiuddin Kazi vs Pranab Chandra Roy Chowdhury reported in PLD 1950 (Dhaka) 37 and in the case of Khan Ajun Khan vs Government of West Pakistan reported in PLD 1958 (Pesh) 191 the Courts held that where both the Special and the general law are applicable to a matter, the settled principle is that the Special law shall prevail over the general law.
